description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our dedicated nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to oversee all aspects of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about geriatric care, possess strong leadership capabilities, and be committed to fostering a supportive and professional environment for both staff and residents. Join a facility that values excellence and provides a competitive salary for your expertise.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Proven ability to manage, mentor, and develop nursing staff
Excellent clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a reputable skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a priority, permanent full-time opportunity for a leader committed to delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for staff. We are specifically looking for a permanent leader to join our team, as interim candidates will not be considered for this crucial role.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and implementing best practices to achieve optimal resident outcomes. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the quality of care and the professional development of the nursing team.

If you are a visionary nursing leader passionate about making a lasting impact in long-term care, we encourage you to apply. Join a team dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement in resident services.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa or a compact state
Proven leadership and management experience in a healthcare setting
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care environment
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
